brief.name: Keystone
brief.summary: Infrastructure release tooling: independent services assemble into a reliable supported deployment. The load-bearing keystone makes the dependencies visible.
brief.intended_appearance: Satin brushed blue steel and warm copper, machined joints and restrained reflections

concept.metaphor: Independent blue steel service supports meet through a separately machined copper dependency key with matching receiver contours.
concept.treatment: The mark itself as a solid object with depth and softly beveled edges, standing free with no backing.
concept.material: Brushed metal such as steel, brass, or aluminum, with soft directional sheen.

state.intended_appearance: Satin brushed blue steel and warm copper, machined joints and restrained reflections
